notes:
v4.6.5 — bot framework + per-bot universe selector

✨ NEW
• Bot framework (core/bot_framework.py): AI-generated bots now only write a single `decide(symbol, bars, position, account) -> {action, qty, reason}` function. The framework owns yfinance fetches (with MultiIndex flattening), Alpaca symbol translation (BTC-USD → BTC/USD for crypto), order submission, per-symbol error isolation, position lookup, and the outer loop. The AI literally cannot break the data plumbing because it doesn't write any of it — the entire class of bugs from v4.6.4 and earlier (Series-vs-scalar comparisons, missing flush, exiting after one iteration, wrong crypto symbol format) is eliminated by construction.
• Make Bot prompt rewritten: the AI receives a complete working reference template and is instructed to modify only the strategy block + the META placeholders + the BotRunner kwargs. Output is now near-deterministic and passes the v4.6.4 preflight installer + decision validator with a wide margin.
• Per-bot Universe picker: each bot tab has a Universe dropdown. Lists every *_universe.txt that's compatible with this bot's asset_type (parsed from its META block; falls back to 'stocks' for the built-ins). Selection persists per-bot in settings and ships to the bot subprocess via the APEX_BOT_UNIVERSE env var. Built-in LONG/SHORT/DAY bots honor the same env var so you can repoint them at any compatible universe without editing source files.
• Universe asset_type declaration: `# asset_type: crypto` as the first comment line of a *_universe.txt file marks that universe's asset class for the compatibility filter.

🚀 IMPACT
• The reference template uses an SMA-20-over-SMA-50 crossover strategy as a working starting point, so even an empty-prompt 'just make me a stock bot' generates a runnable bot. The user only describes WHAT THEY WANT and the AI fills in WHAT TO TRADE on top of correct boilerplate.
• Crypto bots automatically get correct Alpaca symbol mapping (BTC-USD → BTC/USD) and skip SHORT/COVER (Alpaca doesn't allow shorting crypto). These are framework-level enforcement, not AI-prompt suggestions, so they cannot regress.

Includes v4.6.4 META + pip preflight, v4.6.3 silent installer, v4.6.2 universe split + transition cleanup.
